source:
@@U04106@@
We come here, Sire, hoping we're not unwelcome. Foresight can be a good thing, even when not needed. As you know, the mountain people are well versed in the lore of nature and rocks. The spirits who once lived on the low plains have left there now, more attracted than ever to mountain ranges. It’s there they work quietly in cavernous labyrinths, surrounded by precious gases of metallic vapors, testing, separating, combining— with one only purpose: to discover the not-yet-discovered. With subtle power of mind they create transparent forms, and then in the ever-silent depths of the crystal they read of events in the upper world.

@@U04108@@
Yes, so I’ve heard, and I believe you. But why, my good man, should it interest me now?

@@U04110@@
I remind you, Sire, of the Sabine necromancer of Norcia, your ever-faithful and devoted servant. What a dreadful fate once threatened him! Twigs crackled, kindling, flames had begun licking upward, dry logs placed crosshatch around, mingled with pitch and sticks of sulfur— neither man, God, nor Devil could have saved him; except for Your Majesty who burst those chains of fire.
translation:
@@U04106@@
陛下，我们来到这里，希望我们不受欢迎。即使不需要，远见也可能是一件好事。如您所知，山民深谙自然和岩石的知识。曾经居住在低平原上的灵魂现在已经离开了那里，比以往任何时候都更被山脉所吸引。在那里，他们在巨大的迷宫中安静地工作，周围环绕着珍贵的金属蒸气气体，测试、分离、结合——只有一个目的：发现尚未发现的东西。他们用微妙的心灵力量创造出透明的形态，然后在水晶永远寂静的深处，他们读到了上层世界发生的事件。

@@U04108@@
是的，我听说过，而且我相信你。但为什么，我的好人，我现在应该对它感兴趣呢？

@@U04110@@
陛下，我让您想起诺尔恰的萨宾死灵法师，您永远忠诚的仆人。曾经有多么可怕的命运威胁着他！树枝噼啪作响，着火了，火焰开始向上蔓延，干燥的原木交叉排列在周围，与沥青和硫磺棒混合在一起——无论是人、上帝还是魔鬼都无法拯救他；除了摧毁那些火链的陛下。
